ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible surface consists of >95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with minimal high-intensity (white) variance confined to the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 115 degrees and a low depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entirety of the trailing edge; characterized by irregular sawtooth peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweeping laterally and upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular clusters of light-colored pixels (barnacle colonization) localized exclusively on the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization/encrustation on the distal extremities, creating a textured, multi-tonal irregular border at the tips.
